paper.title_en: Dual entropy gain by radiation at the zero temperature limit
paper.abstract_en: Recently we have demonstrated that black hole radiation can be smoothly extended to the zero-temperature limit. Here we analyse entropy variations at the zero temperature limit and evaluate the validity of the Generalized Second Law (GSL). Typically one verifies that the entropy gain in the exterior region compensates for the entropy loss of the black hole due to evaporation. However an anomalous feature emerges at the zero temperature limit. The fact that the emission is restricted to the modes $ω<mΩ$, renders the variation of the horizon area of a Kerr black hole positive definite. Simultaneously the von Neumann entropy of the exterior region increases both for bosonic and fermionic modes. The dual entropy gain at the zero temperature limit marks a robust conservation of the GSL. We demonstrate that the dual increase also applies to Kerr-Taub-NUT black holes whose entropy is neither directly proportional to the horizon area nor analytically integrable.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了零温极限下黑洞辐射的熵变，涉及广义第二定律（GSL）的成立性，对Kerr和Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞有具体分析，符合黑洞热力学主题。
decision.title_zh: 零温极限下辐射的双重熵增益
decision.abstract_zh: 最近我们证明了黑洞辐射可以平滑地扩展到零温极限。在这里，我们分析零温极限下的熵变化，并评估广义第二定律（GSL）的有效性。通常人们验证外部区域的熵增加补偿了黑洞因蒸发造成的熵损失。然而，在零温极限出现了一个异常特征。发射被限制在模$\omega<m\Omega$的事实使得Kerr黑洞的视界面积变化是正定的。同时，外部区域的冯·诺依曼熵对玻色子和费米子模都增加。零温极限下的双重熵增益标志着GSL的稳健守恒。我们证明这种双重增加也适用于Kerr-Taub-NUT黑洞，其熵既不直接与视界面积成正比，也不可解析积分。
